analysis.reasonEn: RSI has recovered from oversold territory to 46.2, and the MACD histogram is improving, signaling a bottoming process. A Higher Low pattern has formed, with the 5-day low exceeding the 20-day low, indicating recovery. Despite a 18.99% surge with low volume (0.39 ratio), the overall indicator improvement supports buying.
